title: Reed, Hide and String
summary: The Hag smashed the band's instruments on her way out. Bufo the bandleader needs bamboo for the flutes, rabbit hide for the drums and string for the guitars.

goals.say: Bufo turns a new flute over in his hands, blows one note, and has to sit down for a moment. 'Right,' he says, a bit hoarse. 'Right. Now the maraca.'
goals.name: Bufo the Bandleader

threats.name: Bufo the Bandleader
threats.target_line: If you've come for a song, there isn't one. Ribbit.
talk: Took the maraca, smashed the flutes, put her foot through the bongos and called my guitar 'a lute for toads'. I am a toad. That's not the point.
Bamboo for flutes, rabbit hide for the drums, string for the guitars. Then we're a band again. A band with no beat, but a band.
That's the hard part. She lives alone and she's got a temper and a cauldron. I've got a flute. You see the problem.
threats.delivered_line: Bufo turns a new flute over in his hands, blows one note, and has to sit down for a moment. 'Right,' he says, a bit hoarse. 'Right. Now the maraca.'
